data.desc: Strive is a structured finance company focused on disciplined capital allocation and long term value creation. We have strategically adopted bitcoin as our hurdle rate for capital deployment because of our fiduciary duty to maximize long-term value for stockholders and compound purchasing power over time. Strive Asset Management, LLC, a direct, wholly owned subsidiary of Strive and an SEC -registered investment adviser, manages over $2.8 billion in assets. Learn more at strive.com.
